//: HAND-DEPLOY ONLY - arena artifacts Hosting site (burnbar-arena-artifacts).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS SEPARATELY FROM firebase.json
The credentialed CI hosting lane resolves every site it publishes through a
hosting TARGET ALIAS in .firebaserc, and scripts/ci/deploy-firebase-hosting-rest.mjs
asserts .firebaserc holds the exact reviewed two-target map (marketing plus
console, production plus staging) and nothing else. The arena site must never be
reachable from that lane, so it has no alias there at all. This config names the
site DIRECTLY via the site key instead of the target key, which makes it
hand-deployable with zero .firebaserc involvement - and leaves it undeployable by
CI, which only ever passes a generated firebase-hosting.ci.json.
HAND-DEPLOY, run from the repository root
This config must sit beside firebase.json: firebase-tools resolves the public dir
relative to the config file directory, not the working directory.
firebase deploy --only hosting:burnbar-arena-artifacts --config firebase.arena.json --project burnbar --non-interactive
Do NOT run firebase target:apply hosting arena-artifacts ... to make this site
alias-addressable again. That rewrites .firebaserc and breaks the production
hosting deploy at the assertion described above.
DRIFT
The hosting entry below is a VERBATIM copy of the reviewed arena-artifacts entry
in firebase.json with the target key swapped for the site key. firebase.json
stays the single reviewed definition: scripts/ci/write-firebase-hosting-ci-config.mjs
validates its public dir, pins its publish allowlist, then deliberately drops it
from every generated CI config. The copy is kept honest by
scripts/ci/deploy-firebase-hosting-rest.test.mjs, which fails on any drift.
PUBLISH ALLOWLIST
The ignore list is an allowlist, not a denylist: it denies every top-level entry
and every subtree except index.html and bundles, then denies the three arena
de-anonymisation key files by literal name as defence in depth. It encodes a glob
gotcha - an ignore pattern of the form DIR-slash-star-star also drops DIR itself,
so BOTH admitted names must be repeated in the subtree pattern; a shortened
bang-paren-bundles subtree pattern would silently stop publishing index.html.
Measured with the pinned firebase-tools 15.23.0 listFiles matcher: 3876 files on
disk under arena-public, 3871 published, zero key files.
EDITING THIS COMMENT
firebase-tools loads config through cjson, which strips comments before parsing.
Its stripper tracks strings by hand and treats any quote preceded by a backslash
as escaped. So keep this array free of backslashes, of double quotes, and of
slash-star sequences - any one of them desynchronises the stripper and the whole
file then fails to load with a confusing error pointing somewhere else entirely.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'none'; frame-ancestors https://burnbar.ai https://www.burnbar.ai https://burnbar.web.app https://burnbar.firebaseapp.com http://127.0.0.1:5500 http://localhost:5500; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
